definitions.explanation: Relating to regular, routine activities or aspects of daily life.

examples.japanese: {日常|にちじょう}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{使|つか}います→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use it in everyday life.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日常|にちじょう}⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われます→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: This is often used in everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: {日常|にちじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{戻|もど}りましょう→戻る：01117_modoru⟧。
examples.english: Let's return to our daily work.

notes:
{日常|にちじょう} describes the ordinary, routine aspects of life. It can function as a noun ("daily life") or as a no-adjective modifier ("everyday").

COMPOUNDS:
- {日常|にちじょう}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: everyday life
- {日常|にちじょう}⟦{会話|かいわ}→会話：01271_kaiwa⟧: everyday conversation
- {日常|にちじょう}⟦{茶飯事|さはんじ}→茶飯事：19325_sahanji⟧: everyday occurrence, routine matter
- ⟦{日常的|にちじょうてき}→日常的：16902_nichijouteki⟧: routine, everyday (na-adjective form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日常|にちじょう}: everyday, ordinary
- ⟦{非日常|ひにちじょう}→非日常：14669_hinichijou⟧: extraordinary, out of the ordinary

USAGE:
As a modifier, takes ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: {日常|にちじょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ (daily work). The derived form ⟦{日常的|にちじょうてき}→日常的：16902_nichijouteki⟧ works as a na-adjective: ⟦{日常的|にちじょうてき}→日常的：16902_nichijouteki⟧な⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ (routine tasks).
